lesson_description: In this lesson, students will explore validation techniques such as the Forge 231 Ovation Rubric to mitigate risk and ensure successful innovation. Through case studies, students will analyze how validation can lead to successful solutions. The lesson covers the importance of user-centric innovation, including problem and customer validation, user personas, and the customer development process. Additionally, students will learn about the concept of Minimum Usable Prototype (MUP), design a compelling value proposition, and understand the systematic concept generation and evaluation process for solution concepts.

subtopics.title: Understanding Validation Techniques
subtopics.description: Explore the Forge 231 Ovation Rubric and its application in validating innovation solutions.

subtopics.title: User-Centric Innovation
subtopics.description: Learn about problem and customer validation, user personas, and the customer development process.

subtopics.title: Customer Interviews and Field Visits
subtopics.description: Master the art of conducting customer interviews and field visits to gather insights.

subtopics.title: Minimum Usable Prototype (MUP) Challenges
subtopics.description: Identify and address challenges in creating a Minimum Usable Prototype (MUP).

subtopics.title: Designing a Compelling Value Proposition
subtopics.description: Develop and craft a compelling value proposition for your solution.

subtopics.title: Concept Generation and Evaluation
subtopics.description: Learn the systematic process for generating and evaluating solution concepts.

subtopics.title: System Thinking in Innovation
subtopics.description: Understand the principles of system thinking and its application in innovation.

subtopics.title: Concept Validation and Technology Alternatives
subtopics.description: Evaluate technology alternatives and assess the feasibility of solution concepts.

subtopics.title: Empathy and User Validation
